## What it is

WeGoTrip sells this as a self-guided tour in Titusville, United States. It starts at Space Commerce Way, Merritt Island.

## How WeGoTrip describes it

> Blast your imagination into the stratosphere, with a ticket to Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex℠. Bringing the epic story of the U.S. space program to life, Kennedy Space Center offers more amazing family fun and mind-blowing science exhibits than you could possibly fit into one day - but you can certainly try! Stand in awe under the gigantic Saturn V, the largest rocket ever flown, see the iconic Space Shuttle Atlantis®, celebrate the pioneers of NASA’s early space programs, and more.
